pick.name: Upwork
pick.why: Largest buyer pool for AI/automation work; variable 0-15% fee (~10% typical) disclosed per proposal
pick.free_limits: Free account; Connects needed to bid (price/free allotment unverified)

alts.name: Contra
alts.why: 0% commission; good for invoicing direct clients and a portfolio; Pro USD 29/mo
alts.free_limits: Free plan has client payment fee (USD 15-29 on >USD 500) and 5% digital-product fee

alts.name: Toptal
alts.why: Highest rates if you pass screening; slow
alts.free_limits: Free to apply (details not on page)

candidates.name: Direct (site + LinkedIn + Apollo + Cal.com)
candidates.verdict: Best margin long-term; use alongside the pick

candidates.name: Contra
candidates.verdict: 0% commission; for direct clients and portfolio

decision: Use Upwork to win the first paid AI projects and reviews (narrow niche profile, e.g. 'Claude agents / MCP integrations'). Run direct outbound in parallel and move repeat clients off-platform once contracts allow. Payout/FIRA handling to India was not checked.
details: Upwork's official fee page blocked fetch (403); figures are from secondary 2026 sources (unverified).

verify.note: Upwork's official fee page is blocked, and the source is a third-party blog (hireinsouth), which breaks the primary-source rule for a fee. Contra alt is confirmed (USD 15/29 client-payment fee, 5% digital fee min USD 3 max 29; Pro USD 29/mo or 199/yr). Verify Upwork's fee on upwork.com before relying on '0-15%'.
